name: How much does it cost to design and build an outdoor lounge area in Los Angeles?
description: Costs for an outdoor lounge in Los Angeles range from $15,000 for basic designs to over $75,000 for custom luxury spaces, depending on features and materials.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to design and build an outdoor lounge area in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of designing and building an outdoor lounge area in Los Angeles varies significantly based on size, materials, features, and complexity. A basic, well-appointed lounge might start from $15,000 to $25,000, while custom-built luxury spaces with integrated kitchens, high-end finishes, and advanced technology can easily exceed $75,000. Factors like grading, utility extensions, custom millwork, and high-quality landscaping also influence the total investment.
